intro: Joel begins with a disaster: a plague of locusts that strips the land bare. He sees in it a warning of the day of the LORD.
Chapter one mourns the plague. Chapter two calls the people to return with all their heart, and promises: I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh.
Chapter three tells of the nations judged, and God dwelling with his people.
Little is known of Joel himself.
Listen for the call: rend your heart, and not your garments.
